name: ahrena-engineering-development
description: Development orchestrated issue→stacked-PRs: Athena, the tech-lead, plans a change, routes each concern deterministic-first — a route table, then the Clef decision gate, then a human — delegates to the build clades, runs the develop→Argos loop before each layer opens, and escalates when it is exhausted. Also installs the agency in a repository, enabling the plugins the build path needs.
